_about: The branch of Wenzel Kastl, one of the seven brothers. See docs/EXTRACTION.md.

sources.quote: The brothers were Peter, Wenzel (James), Jan (John), Joseph, Jakub, Thomas, and Andrew
Wenzel Kastl was born 26 February 1831 in Vsepadly, Bohemia, house No. 11
Wenzel married Barbara Blachnik in Bohemia.

facts.value: Arrived at Baltimore 2 October 1867 on the Humbolt, from Bremen

sources.quote: Wenzel and Barbara came to the United States in 1867, arriving at the Port of Baltimore on October 2. They left from the Port of Bremen, Germany on the vessel Humbolt
On October 2, 1867, Wenzel; wife Barbara and three children John, Martin, and Wenzel arrived on the ship SS Humbolt.
Joseph was buried at Brainard, Nebraska; Wenzel at Omaha, and Thomas in Illinois.

facts.value: Unknown — "where he died, or was buried" not found

sources.quote: We have not been able to find much about Wenzel; where he died, or was buried.
